title: Bad News from the Kiln

pre.en: What does Tom think the cracked mug is?
pre.zh: Tom 以为那个裂了的杯子是什么？

intro: 小陈和陶艺老师 Ruth 的一段微信式聊天：小陈准备送给室友 Tom 的杯子在窑里烧裂了。读的时候留意第三条件句 If + had done, would have done：假设过去换个做法，结果会怎样——这些事其实都没发生。结尾小陈的回答值得细品。

sentences.en: Bad news from the kiln, I'm afraid: your mug for Tom has cracked.
sentences.zh: 恐怕是个坏消息：你给 Tom 做的杯子在窑里裂了。
sentences.speaker: Ruth

sentences.en: I've sent you a photo.
sentences.zh: 照片发你了。

sentences.en: Oh no, I'm gutted.
sentences.zh: 啊不会吧，我太难受了。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: I'd been looking forward to giving it to him on Friday.
sentences.zh: 我一直盼着星期五把它送给他呢。

sentences.en: Do you want to know what went wrong?
sentences.zh: 想知道哪儿出问题了吗？
sentences.speaker: Ruth

sentences.en: If you'd let it dry for another day, it wouldn't have cracked.
sentences.zh: 你要是让它再多晾一天，就不会裂了。

sentences.en: And if the handle hadn't been so thick, the clay would have dried evenly.
sentences.zh: 还有，把手要是没那么厚，泥也会干得均匀些。

sentences.en: Ah, that explains it.
sentences.zh: 啊，这就说得通了。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: I put it on the heater on Saturday night to save time.
sentences.zh: 为了省时间，我星期六晚上把它放暖气上烘了。

sentences.en: I'd even filled in a form to get it into today's kiln.
sentences.zh: 我还专门填了表，好赶上今天这一窑。

sentences.en: Classic beginner's mistake.
sentences.zh: 典型的新手错误。
sentences.speaker: Ruth

sentences.en: If you'd asked me, I'd have told you to keep it away from the heater.
sentences.zh: 你要是问过我，我肯定会让你别把它放暖气旁边。

sentences.en: If only I'd waited one more day.
sentences.zh: 早知道再等一天就好了。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Can I just glue the crack, or will it fall apart?
sentences.zh: 我拿胶把裂缝粘上行吗？还是会散架？

sentences.en: It'll fall apart the first time Tom puts it in the dishwasher.
sentences.zh: Tom 第一次把它放进洗碗机，它就会散。
sentences.speaker: Ruth

sentences.en: Honestly, it's not the end of the world.
sentences.zh: 说真的，又不是天塌下来了。

sentences.en: I've cracked hundreds of pots myself.
sentences.zh: 我自己烧裂的罐子都有好几百个了。

sentences.en: And you still got your money's worth — it was a useful experiment.
sentences.zh: 而且你这钱也没白花——就当做了个有用的实验。

sentences.en: What a shame, though.
sentences.zh: 不过还是太可惜了。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: If it had survived, Tom would have been thrilled.
sentences.zh: 它要是没裂，Tom 肯定高兴坏了。

sentences.en: If this were a shop mug, I'd just send it back.
sentences.zh: 要是店里买的杯子，我直接退回去就完了。

sentences.en: Never mind.
sentences.zh: 算了。

sentences.en: He'll have to do without a mug this year.
sentences.zh: 今年只好委屈他，没有杯子了。

sentences.en: I'll give him socks instead — I got a good deal on a pack of five last week.
sentences.zh: 我改送他袜子吧——上周刚好买到一包五双的，挺划算。

sentences.en: Quick update — I wrapped the cracked mug anyway and gave it to Tom.
sentences.zh: 汇报一下——我最后还是把那个裂了的杯子包好送给了 Tom。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: He held it up to the light and said, "Is this one of those expensive Japanese ones? It's brilliant."
sentences.zh: 他把杯子举起来对着光看，说：「这是那种很贵的日本杯子吧？太棒了。」

sentences.en: I said, "Yes. Yes, it is."
sentences.zh: 我说：「对。对，就是。」

cards.note: 读 /kɪln/，n 要发出来；陶器要放进 kiln 里高温烧（fire）。
名词也是 crack：glue the crack（把裂缝粘上）。
to feel very disappointed and sad about something
cards.tip: 英式口语，非常常用；比 disappointed 语气重得多，正式场合别用。
cards.example: He was gutted when his team lost in the last minute.

cards.note: to stop happening or working in the way you planned
cards.tip: 某东西出了毛病用 with：go wrong with sth；Everything went wrong（诸事不顺）。
cards.example: Something went wrong with the printer, so I couldn't print the tickets.

cards.note: 当动词是「处理、应付」：handle a problem。
形容词 even（平的、均匀的）。
something you say when you suddenly understand why something happened
cards.tip: 口语里也常说 That explains a lot.（这就全明白了），带一点调侃。
cards.example: "I left the window open all night." "That explains it — the room's freezing."

cards.note: to write the information that is asked for on a form
to break into pieces because it is old or badly made

cards.text: it's not the end of the world
cards.zh: 又不是天塌下来了；没那么严重
cards.note: something you say to tell someone that a problem is not very serious
cards.tip: 用来安慰别人或自己；也说 It won't be the end of the world if …
cards.example: You failed one test — it's not the end of the world.

cards.note: to get enough use or value from something you paid for
something you say when you are disappointed or sorry about something
cards.tip: 这里的 shame 是「可惜」，不是「羞耻」；也说 What a pity。
cards.example: You can't come to the party? What a shame!

cards.note: to be very happy and excited about something
to return something by post because it is wrong or you do not want it
cards.tip: 代词放中间：send it back；退回给谁用 to。
cards.example: The shoes were too small, so I sent them back.

cards.note: something you say to show that something is not important, or that you will stop worrying about it
cards.tip: 对别人的道歉说「没关系」用 That's OK / No problem 更自然；Never mind 多是自己放下、叫对方别在意。
cards.example: Never mind — we can take the next train.

cards.zh: 没有（某物）也行；将就着不用
cards.tip: 常和 have to / can 连用；不带宾语也行：We'll do without。
cards.example: There's no milk, so we'll have to do without.

cards.note: to buy something at a good price
cards.tip: 在什么东西上划算用 on：a good deal on sth；更夸张可以说 a great deal。
cards.example: We got a good deal on the flights because we booked early.

cards.note: 包礼物 wrap a present；包装纸 wrapping paper。
